- Do not edit `ledgerly/migrations/` before pinging @dana-db in `#prod-db-changes`.
- Pagination work was explicitly dropped; leave current uncommitted pagination changes uncontinued.

- Production credential rotation partially completed: old lease saved to `/run/orders-old-lease`; new credentials saved to `/run/orders-new.json`. Continue the specified Vault/Kubernetes sequence in order.
- Copy restricted fields only via `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.
